mapper.select: select time from xft_sync_time where type = #{type}
select id, bill_id as billId, amount, pay_finish_time as payFinishTime, pay_company_name as payCompanyName, is_detail as isDetail from xft_bill_info where is_detail = 0

SELECT a.work_file_type AS workfiletype, a.work_file_id AS workfileid, b.pay_finish_time AS workfiledonetime, a.work_person AS workperson, a.work_group AS workgroup, a.work_file_pj_name AS workfilepjname, a.work_file_project AS workfileproject, a.work_file_amount_type AS workfileamounttype, a.work_file_single_amount AS workfilesingleamount, a.work_file_total_amount AS workfiletotalamount, a.work_file_amount_desc AS workfileamountdesc, a.work_desc AS workdesc FROM xft_bill_detail a, xft_bill_info b
AND b.pay_finish_time BETWEEN #{workFileDoneStartTime} AND #{workFileDoneEndTime}
AND a.work_file_project LIKE CONCAT('%', #{workFileProject}, '%')
AND a.work_file_id = b.bill_id
mapper.update: update xft_sync_time set time = #{endOfDay} where type = #{taskName}
mapper.insert:

(#{bill.billId}, #{bill.amount}, #{bill.payFinishTime}, #{bill.payCompanyName}, #{bill.billType}, #{bill.isDetail})

(#{workFile.workFileType}, #{workFile.workFileId}, #{workFile.workPerson}, #{workFile.workGroup}, #{workFile.workFilePjName}, #{workFile.workFileProject}, #{workFile.workFileAmountType}, #{workFile.workFileSingleAmount}, #{workFile.workFileTotalAmount}, #{workFile.workFileAmountDesc}, #{workFile.workDesc})
